name: birdseye
description: One command turns any repo into an interactive flowchart: the major modules, the folders and files inside them, and the dependency arrows between them. Local tree-sitter parse, no model call, zero tokens. One self-contained HTML file out.

interface.shortDescription: Map any repo into one local, zero-token architecture flowchart.
interface.longDescription: birdsEye runs local tree-sitter extraction and writes one self-contained HTML map of a repository's modules, files, and dependency arrows. It does not call a model.
defaultPrompt: Build a birdsEye map for this repo.
